label: Scottish statutory instruments made from 1999 to 2026 and UK statutory instruments made from 1987 to 2026
not_covered: statutory instruments made before 1987 (held by legislation.gov.uk only as scanned images); Welsh and Northern Ireland series published separately from the UK series; instruments published on legislation.gov.uk without their text (mostly temporary traffic orders); instruments made under an EU regulation or another Order rather than an Act; and any instrument published after the last refresh
source: legislation.gov.uk as-made XML preambles; tools/madeunder_probe.py (FIX_PLAN P3.31)
